covers: JSE close on Friday 13 November 2026 and the first hour of the US session to about 17:22 SAST
headline: Chip stocks slide at the US open (AMD -9.6%, Nvidia -3.9%) after the 6.5% PPI print; JSE ends 0.4% lower and the rand near R16.94/$
summary: The JSE All Share closed at 112,387.86 (-0.4%) and the Top 40 at 104,486.62 (-0.5%), with SPAR down 4.4% and Standard Bank 2.1% lower after a reported R17 million fine (LRC Market Dashboard and LRC Stock Scanner (Yahoo Finance), 13 Nov 2026; Daily Investor headline). In New York the Nasdaq was 1.8% lower and the S&P 500 1.1% lower at about 17:22 SAST as AMD, Broadcom and Applied Materials fell more than 6%, following US producer inflation of 6.5% a year and a 5.15% 10-year yield (LRC Market Dashboard and LRC Stock Scanner (Yahoo Finance), 13 Nov 2026; CNBC headlines). The rand was at R16.94/$, 2.8% weaker on the week, gold at $3,896.70 (-4.4% on the week) and Brent at $96.45 (LRC Market Dashboard (Yahoo Finance), 6-13 Nov 2026).

items.title: Chip stocks sell off at the Wall Street open: AMD -9.6%, Broadcom and Applied Materials -6.2%, Nvidia -3.9%
items.summary: At 17:22 SAST AMD was at $528.92, Broadcom at $341.71, Applied Materials at $357.15 and Nvidia at $159.74, extending this week's slide. Cisco was 5.0% lower at $96.87 despite Thursday's earnings beat, while Cerebras was 8.0% higher at $105.56 after its results and Microsoft deal. CNBC also reports Treasury Secretary Bessent criticising Nvidia chip 'leakage' to China.
items.source: LRC Stock Scanner quotes (Yahoo Finance AMD, AVGO, AMAT, NVDA, CSCO, CBRS), 13 Nov 2026 17:22 SAST; CNBC headline, 13 Nov 2026 16:53 SAST

items.title: Nasdaq down 1.8%, S&P 500 down 1.1% early on Friday after the 6.5% PPI print
items.summary: The S&P 500 was at 7,506.70 and the Nasdaq at 24,920.67 at about 17:22 SAST, against Thursday closes of 7,592.40 and 25,366.09. Both are still higher on the week (S&P 500 +1.8%, Nasdaq +1.4%), as CNBC notes. October producer prices rose 0.3% on the month for an annual rate of 6.5%, and the US 10-year yield was at 5.15%. Chicago Fed President Goolsbee says the Fed 'has definitely got work to do' on inflation.
items.source: LRC Market Dashboard (Yahoo Finance ^GSPC, ^IXIC, ^TNX), 6, 12 and 13 Nov 2026; CNBC headlines, 13 Nov 2026 16:02, 16:22 and 17:06 SAST

items.title: JSE ends the week lower: All Share -0.4% on the day at 112,387.86, Top 40 -0.5% at 104,486.62
items.summary: Against Thursday's closes of 112,894.87 and 104,981.31, the All Share finished 0.4% lower and the Top 40 0.5% lower; on the week the All Share is down 0.3% and the Top 40 0.2%. Naspers ended 1.4% lower at R725.37 and Prosus 0.2% lower at R670.40; gold miners were mixed (Gold Fields +0.1%, AngloGold Ashanti -0.1%, Harmony -0.2%). Vodacom gained 1.1% to R179.93.
